title: Special Educator
description: Support children with special needs through individualized learning plans and classroom guidance.
responsibilities: Track student progress and provide reports
requirements: Degree in Special Education or related field
Experience working with children with disabilities

title: Occupational Therapist
description: Help children improve daily living skills, coordination, and functional independence.
responsibilities: Work with families on home programs

title: Speech Therapist
description: Provide speech and language support for children who need communication intervention.
requirements: Degree in Speech and Hearing / Speech Therapy
